chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام.

key_terms.ابْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ: Ibn Abi Nasr, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.دَاوُدَ بْنِ سِرْحَانَ: Dawud ibn Sirhan, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.سَهْلُ: Sahl, the first narrator named in the chain
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: meaning that this narration is the same as the preceding one

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in al-Istibsar say about a traveler who dies without relatives present?
ai.summary: This report provides only the sanad/isnad and then indicates that the wording or ruling is the same as a previous hadith. It belongs to a jurisprudential discussion concerning the death of a man or woman during travel when no close relative of the same relevant category is present.
